title: Learning by Doing: Autonomously Compiling and Curating Agent Skills from Verified Traces
abstract: arXiv:2611.01386v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Memory systems for production LLM agents mostly store semantic memory (facts about users and domains) or episodic memory (earlier interactions). Research systems such as Trace2Skill, WikiSkill, and SkillRevise learn procedures from agent runs, package them as Skills, and evaluate them on benchmarks. We describe Zep Agent Skills, a production service that gives deployed agents this procedural memory. The service uses only verified attempts as evidence, cites the supporting events for each field of a Skill, and governs the admission and distribution of each Skill version. The service records each task attempt as a Trace with ordered events, an outcome, and a verification strength. A compiler with separate Reflector and Curator roles turns verified Traces into versioned Skills. Scans and admission gates control which candidates become active, and verified use outcomes change the search rank of each Skill. The Agent Skills format is an ope

translated_title: 从实践中学习：从经验证的轨迹中自主编译与策划智能体技能
translated_abstract: 面向生产级LLM智能体的记忆系统大多存储语义记忆（关于用户和领域的事实）或情景记忆（先前的交互记录）。诸如Trace2Skill、WikiSkill和SkillRevise等研究系统从智能体运行中学习程序性知识，将其打包为技能，并在基准测试中进行评估。我们介绍了Zep Agent Skills，这是一个为已部署智能体提供程序性记忆的生产服务。该服务仅使用经过验证的任务尝试作为证据，为技能的每个字段引用其支持的事件，并对每个技能版本的准入和分发进行治理。该服务将每次任务尝试记录为一条Trace（轨迹），包含有序事件、结果以及验证强度。一个具有独立Reflector（反思者）和Curator（策展者）角色的编译器将经验证的轨迹转化为带版本管理的技能。扫描机制和准入门槛控制哪些候选技能可以被激活，而经验证的使用结果会调整每个技能的搜索排名。Agent Skills格式是一个开放……
tldr: Zep Agent Skills是一个生产级服务，它仅以经过验证的任务尝试为证据，将智能体运行轨迹自主编译为带版本管理的程序性技能记忆，并通过准入控制与经验证的使用结果来治理技能的激活、分发与搜索排名。
en_tdlr: Zep Agent Skills is a production service that autonomously compiles verified agent task traces into versioned procedural skill memories, governing skill admission, distribution, and search ranking through admission gates and verified use outcomes.
